band_astro_hallfault: CLOUDY: HALL TAP FAULT – NO MOVE
band_astro_nocal: CLOUDY: TRAVEL TIME NOT CALIBRATED – NO MOVE
band_commission: SETUP PROGRAM MISSING: AUTOMATIC LOCKED – CONTINUE AT THE DISPLAY
band_manual_nowind: MANUAL: ANEMOMETER FAULT – NO STORM PROTECTION
band_pos_hallfault: TILT {deg}°: HALL TAP FAULT – NO MOVE
band_pos_hold_unknown: TILT {deg}° ON COMMAND (POSITION UNKNOWN) – AUTOMATIC PAUSED
band_pos_nocal: TILT {deg}°: TRAVEL TIME NOT CALIBRATED – NO MOVE
band_pos_reference: TILT {deg}°: REFERENCE MOVE TO FLAT POSITION
band_sensor_supply: SUN SENSOR: SHORT CIRCUIT OR OVERLOAD IN CABLE
band_setup: SETUP NOT COMPLETED – NO DRIVE WILL MOVE
band_storm_moving: STORM PROTECTION: MOVING TO FLAT POSITION
band_syncreset_azimuth: SYNC CONTROLLER RESET – AZIMUTH MOVING TO HOME POSITION
band_syncreset_elevation: SYNC CONTROLLER RESET – SYSTEM MOVING FLAT
band_windfault_moving: ANEMOMETER FAULT: MOVING TO FLAT POSITION
help_control: Commands as at the display: automatic, manual drive with dead man, angles, park, acknowledge
help_messages: Latest messages of the device with time and level, filterable
help_overview: Wind, sun sensor, tilt and status band like the start page of the display
help_setup: State of the setup program and key values of the test report, display only
help_sun_path: Arc of the sun today from the position of the sun of the device (firmware 0.7.0 or newer)
help_values: Measured values and state of the device at a glance
lock_auto: Switch the automatic off for the manual drive
lock_auto_note: Manual drive only with the automatic off (switch at the top right).
lock_commission_note: The setup program is not completed: the automatic is locked. Continue it at the display, with somebody watching the rack.
lock_offline_note: No connection to the device: every button is off.
lock_remote: Remote control locked at the display
lock_remote_note: "Remote control locked" is switched on at the display: every button is off; messages keep coming.
lock_setup_note: Without completed setup no drive moves. The setup is done only at the display.
lock_storm_note: Storm protection active: drives are locked, only acknowledging is possible.
lock_update_note: A firmware update is being written: all outputs are off, commands are refused.
messages_lost: {n} messages lost since the start of the adapter
note_dead_man: Manual drive only while held (dead man); automatic must be off. "Remote control locked" at the display disables every button.
note_sync_reset_running: Reset of the synchronous control in progress: the axis is blocked until it ends.
polar_day: Polar day: the sun does not set
polar_night: Polar night: the sun does not rise
setup_needs_firmware: The setup program needs firmware 0.7.0 or newer
show_sync_reset: Offer the reset of the synchronous control (with a question first)
sun_needs_firmware: The position of the sun needs firmware 0.7.0 or newer
sun_no_site: No site entered (setup at the display)
sun_no_time: The device has no time yet (network and time server at the display)
sun_unknown: Position of the sun not known
sync_reset_question_azimuth: The azimuth moves to its home position. Make sure nobody is in the swivel range. Start the reset now?
sync_reset_question_elevation: The whole system moves to the flat position. Make sure nobody is in the swivel range. Start the reset now?
